verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the orange divider sits alone near the top above a huge dead band, the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, the body is jammed right under the headline, and the legal text is shrunk to an unreadable smudge. B keeps the original structure and hierarchy, but it is basically a scaled-down copy. The eyebrow almost touches the divider, the one-line headline runs nearly edge to edge, the body and CTA text are small, the sun logo looks squashed, and the bottom third is still empty.
